services.name: Process Definition Service
services.description: Stores schemas and rules for process(es), Provides validation config, UI bundle, and label configuration.

services.name: RequestSubmission Service
services.description: Manages the submission process, generates UI using compiled bundles, Validates input using shared validation engine. Stores request (=submissions)

services.name: Civil Servant Review Service
services.description: Service that allows CivilServant to review the fields of request, submit comments Per-field or confirm/reject per field and an overall comment for request.

services.name: Approval Workflow Service
services.description: Multi step approvals flow, configured per process, managed using AWS Step Functions.

services.name: Notification Service
services.description: Listens to events and sends email or SMS via SendGrid.

services.name: Scanning System Service (separate account)
services.description: Manages scan requests using scanning workers and OPSWAT engine cluster.

services.name: Attachment and Scanning Service
services.description: Handles file uploads, scanning orchestration, and attachment tracking per submission.

services.name: SubmissionQueryService
services.description: Read model service that builds a denormalized view of submissions for fast querying.

services.name: Airs - AI Reponse Service
services.description: Generates AI-based responses and recommendations based on policies, documents, and historical data.

services.name: Document Service
services.description: Manages documents, attachments, and versions across the platform.

services.name: Shared Data Service
services.description: Manages shared static or slowly changing reference data across services.

services.name: Task Service
services.description: Handles task generation and lifecycle based on process execution steps.
